title: New Blender UI - The Proposal
summary: Blender Guru's Andrew Price proposes a redesign of Blender's user interface, answering the usability problems raised in earlier parts of the series. He later noted the proposal had flaws and posted a follow-up.
why: Seen as an inflection point in how Blender's UI was perceived, and as helping kick off the 2.8 redesign.

quote.text: I think Blender Guru's videos kicked off a lot of the 2.8 design work
